title: 📱 New Security Update for Galaxy S25 and S24 Fixes 179 Flaws!
body: 📱 New Security Update for Galaxy S25 and S24 Fixes 179 Flaws!

Samsung began sending the November 2026 security update to the Galaxy S24 and Galaxy S25 series, and the update fixes 179 security vulnerabilities in Android and Samsung software. The update started arriving in South Korea first, and is expected to expand to more countries in the coming days. The download is about 622 MB for the S24 series and about 502 MB for the S25 series, and the update also includes the FE versions of both series. You can check for it from Settings, then Software Update, then Check for Updates.
Simply put: a security flaw is a weakness attackers could exploit; monthly security updates close these gaps before they become a problem.
Do you update your phone as soon as security updates arrive?
